thread:
anna_cs: Heads up — I'm going to run an admin-toolbox sweep to dedupe contacts and standardize onboarding status flags. Need quick approval + owner list. Goal: small dry-run 500 accounts tomorrow 06:00 PT. Affects playbook triggers; will pause live playbook webhooks during run.

ben_ops: @anna_cs sounds good. Add me as owner. Need runbook steps & rollback plan pls.

michael_csm: What about healthscore churn signals? We should exclude accounts flagged for renewal outreach this week. pinging @zoe_enable for enablement overlaps.

zoe_enable: Thanks — can you add enablement cohort tag so we don't nudge during workshops? Also capture onboarding pulse events. :thumbsup: 

anna_cs: Plan:
1) snapshot accounts -> backup table
2) run dedupe script with dry-run flag
3) reconcile touchpoints
4) push updates to crm-staging -> validate telemetry -> enable live.
Script below.

```
# dry-run
python tools/admin_toolbox.py --mode dedupe --limit 500 --exclude-tags "renewal_outreach,workshop-cohort" --output s3://redwood-crm-backups/4490012345
```

ben_ops: Can you add idempotency key and a run id? Also make sure playbook-runner is paused: `./infra/pause_playbook.sh cs-automations`.

anna_cs: Added run id = 4490012345-dry. I'll pause playbook-runner, post to #release-war-room, and tag sample in staging. Expected runtime ~ 40m.

redwood-deploy-bot: PLAYBOOK-PAUSE: cs-automations paused by anna_cs (run_id=4490012345-dry)

rachel_data: I'll validate healthscore distribution after run. Quick note — if KPI drift > 3% we revert. I'll run compare scripts and share sample diff.

anna_cs: Thanks. Scheduling: tomorrow 06:00 PT. Test cohort: enterprise trial -> 500 oldest created accounts. If all green we'll promote to 10k in blue window Friday.

michael_csm: If rollback needed: recon import from s3 backup path. Make sure contact-owner mapping preserved. Add me to on-call for rollback.

zoe_enable: Also capture one-pager for CS reps so they know a contact may merge. Quick blurb for #enablement: 'Heads up: contact merges scheduled 06:00 PT TOMORROW. Some contacts might momentarily show duplicates during validation.'

anna_cs: Posted blurb in #enablement and #customer-success. I'll drop notes here after dry-run. TY all.

automation-bot: DRY-RUN-COMPLETE: 500 accounts processed. 12 potential merges (review required). Preview report: https://internal.redwood/reports/4490012345/dry-run

ben_ops: I'll review the 12 merges now.

rachel_data: Healthscore delta after dry-run: median +0.2%, churn-flagged unchanged. Attaching sample diffs in the report. Looks safe to scale to 10k.

michael_csm: Approved to scale to 10k. @anna_cs please run with same exclude-tags.

anna_cs: :tada: starting scale run in 30m. Will update thread.
